items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. TARGETED REPAIR of the supplied ORIGINAL rear three-quarter Japanese anime adult female crescent warrior. The user explicitly corrected a previous edit because it turned her body to face front. The ORIGINAL BACK-TURNED pose is essential. Keep her back and rear three-quarter hips turned toward the viewer, with her head looking back over the shoulder at the viewer, matching the supplied reference's exact head angle, shoulder rotation, spinal curve and hip orientation. Do not rotate the pelvis or torso forward. Do not turn this into a front-facing standing pinup. We should see the BACK/REAR three-quarter surface of her waist/hip outfit and the outer back of the thighs, not the front crotch or abdomen. Preserve original camera angle, weight distribution, leg placement, long black hair, face/red eyes, gold crescent hat, black/red/gold outfit identity, large crimson sash and two gold crescent weapons. This is a rear-view look-back standing illustration.
Make ONLY these corrections while keeping the rear three-quarter pose:
1. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands. Original image has an erroneous third dangling forearm/hand at viewer-left below the waist. Remove that entire extra limb, and reconstruct any small obscured arm connection needed. Keep the arm reaching toward viewer-left and the actual second weapon-bearing arm beside the rear hip on viewer-right. Each real arm connects to one shoulder naturally. The second arm stays behind/along the rear hip without pulling the torso toward the camera. No duplicated hands, no floating wrists.
2. Comfortable real grips: each existing gold crescent blade has a blunt dark grip-bridge inside its opening. Each hand wraps around that grip, four fingers curling and thumb opposing, aligned wrist. Do not grasp sharp edges. Keep the original weapons' general positions and curvature, away from the body.
3. Improve the REAR hip costume: a continuous gold-trimmed waist belt, fitted opaque black combat shorts that fully cover the buttocks and pelvis, plus an elegant overlapping black/red short overskirt draped from the back/side waist, around upper-to-mid thigh. Readable tailored seams on the BACK and SIDE panels. Preserve her rear hip silhouette under the clothing, no front-fly panel visible. Replace confusing garter-like hip fragments with connected cloth, avoid extra exposure. Keep her fitted black thigh boots and existing ornate gold armor design.
Preserve the original delicate refined Japanese anime face; do not Westernize. Keep the overall full-body composition and every foot, weapon and hat tip visible within 1024x1536 portrait. Keep pale grey simple background and faint ground shadow. Clean smooth outlines, grouped hair strands, broad intact fabric panels, no torn edges or random micro-barbs. No scenery, particles, grain, text, watermark or additional person. Priority order: original back-turned orientation first, exactly two connected arms and good grips second, rear hip clothing third. Do not change other features.
